t.title: Karatun Alƙur'ani Mai Girma
t.allImamsSub: Kowace sura da muryar liman daban
t.hintTar: Kowace sura daga shekara daban, wani lokaci tsohuwa, wani lokaci sabuwa
t.dragOff: Alamar tana motsawa idan ka zaɓi Mushafi ko shekara
t.dragOffBar: Ana iya jan sandar idan ka zaɓi Mushafi ko shekara
t.appsH: Saurara a manhajarka ko ka sauke
t.fMusS: Cikakkun Mushafai da aka karanta; Mushafin kowane mai karatu yana da sashensa a cikin manhajar podcast.
t.fTarS: Sallolin Tarawihi na Masallacin Annabi; kowace shekara tana da sashenta a cikin manhajar podcast.
t.fAllS: Dukkan karatuttukan rediyon na masu karatu daban-daban, bisa tsarin Mushafi, kuma sababbin karatuttuka suna zuwa maka kai tsaye.
t.copiedHint: An kwafi mahaɗin. Liƙa shi a manhajarka.
t.alexaMore: Rediyon zai fara daga inda shafin yake watsawa. Don sarrafa shi: “Alexa, next” don sura ta gaba, da “Alexa, stop” don tsayawa.
t.liveH: 1. Rediyon Tartil kai tsaye, watsawa kai tsaye (rediyo)
t.altLiveD: Yana aiki a dukkan na'urori, har da tsofaffi
t.vlcPc: Mahaɗin M3U ko na watsawa kai tsaye a VLC: kwafi mahaɗin → buɗe VLC → Media → Open Network Stream (Ctrl+N) → liƙa mahaɗin → Play. Kunna Loop (maimaitawa) don jerin kunnawa.
t.vlcIos: Mahaɗin M3U ko na watsawa kai tsaye a VLC: kwafi mahaɗin → buɗe VLC → Network → Network Stream → liƙa mahaɗin → Open Network Stream.
t.vlcAnd: Mahaɗin M3U ko na watsawa kai tsaye a VLC: kwafi mahaɗin → buɗe VLC → More → New stream → liƙa mahaɗin → Play. Mahaɗin watsawa kai tsaye yana aiki kuma a kowace manhajar rediyo da ke karɓar ƙara tasha ta hanyar mahaɗi.
t.rssPc: Mahaɗin RSS a Pocket Casts (pocketcasts.com ko manhajar): Search → liƙa mahaɗin kai tsaye a akwatin bincike → Subscribe.
t.rssMac: Mahaɗin RSS a Apple Podcasts (Mac): menu na File → Follow a Show by URL → liƙa mahaɗin.
t.rssAp: Mahaɗin RSS a Apple Podcasts: Library → ⋯ ko Edit → Follow a Show by URL → liƙa mahaɗin.
t.rssOv: Mahaɗin RSS a Overcast: + → Add URL → liƙa mahaɗin.
t.rssAnd: Mahaɗin RSS a Podcast Addict / AntennaPod: maɓallin + → Add by RSS URL → liƙa mahaɗin.
t.rssPcA: Mahaɗin RSS a Pocket Casts: Search → liƙa mahaɗin kai tsaye a akwatin bincike → Subscribe.
t.dlAllHint: Saboda girmansu babu fayil ɗin ZIP guda ɗaya; mafi sauƙi shi ne jerin mahaɗai da za ka saka a manhajar saukewa don ta sauke su duka lokaci ɗaya:
t.dlPc: Kwamfuta: JDownloader ko Internet Download Manager → ƙara mahaɗai → liƙa abin da ke cikin fayil ɗin ko ka shigo da shi.
t.dlAnd: Android: manhajar ADM → shigo da jerin mahaɗai daga fayil ɗin.
t.waqf: Wannan rediyo waƙafi ne saboda Allah Maɗaukaki. Ka taimaka wajen yaɗa shi, domin wanda ya nuna hanyar alheri kamar wanda ya aikata shi ne.
t.mailL: Don ra'ayoyi da shawarwari, kuma duk wanda yake da haƙƙi a kan wani abu da ke nan, za mu cire shi da zarar ya nema:
t.loadErr: Ba a iya loda wannan karatun ba, muna wucewa zuwa na gaba…
t.plErr: Ba a iya loda jerin kunnawa ba.
t.shareMsg: Saurari rediyon “Karatun Alƙur'ani Mai Girma” kai tsaye dare da rana
t.instBarS: Buɗe rediyon da taɓawa ɗaya, kamar manhaja
t.instTpc: Ƙara Tartil zuwa tebur ɗin kwamfuta
t.instIos1: Taɓa maɓallin Raba {share} a sandar burauza
t.instIosN: A Safari maɓallin Raba yana sandar ƙasa
t.instPcS: A Chrome da Edge tagar shigarwa tana bayyana kai tsaye. A sauran burauzoji:
t.instPc2: Firefox: ja alamar kulle daga sandar adireshi zuwa tebur ɗin kwamfuta
t.instPc3: Ko ka adana shafin a alamomi {ctrl}

m.tfSrc: Madogara: Al-Mukhtasar fi Tafsir al-Quran al-Karim, Cibiyar Tafsir don Nazarin Alƙur'ani
m.dockE: Taɓa kowace aya don karanta taƙaitaccen tafsirinta daga “Al-Mukhtasar fi al-Tafsir”, ko kwafe ta, ko saka alamar tsayawa a wurinta.
m.resGo: Ci gaba daga inda na tsaya
m.noMarks: Babu alamomin tsayawa tukuna. Taɓa kowace aya, sannan “Alamar tsayawa”.
m.sPh: Rubuta kalmar Larabci ɗaya ko fiye don bincike a cikin Alƙur'ani
m.sCount: Ayoyi {n} · taɓa sakamako don buɗe shafinsa
m.errLoad: Ba a iya lodawa ba. Duba haɗin intanet ɗinka sannan ka sake gwadawa.
m.lastPos: Wuri na ƙarshe da ka kai
m.credit: Rubutun Mushafi: Cibiyar Sarki Fahd don Buga Alƙur'ani Mai Girma (riwayar Hafs, rubutun KFGQPC Uthmanic Hafs). Lambobin shafuffuka da fihirisar bincike: Tanzil.net. Tafsiri: Al-Mukhtasar, Cibiyar Tafsir don Nazarin Alƙur'ani (tafsir.net), da lasisin CC BY 4.0. Fassarorin ma'anoni: QuranEnc.com, an kawo su ba tare da canji ba.
